title: Public website preview staging with General ooRexx Deployment
summary: General Deployment v0.1-dev4 local preview stage remains verified. New v0.4.5 site-only role assembler produces an install-destination manifest and independently verifies 16 actual candidate files. It stops before owned HTTPS service-unit and TLS/real readiness tests; target-host install and public listening are not observed.
invariants: General Deployment remains sole deployment/staging primitive; Rasen Falcon owns only application-specific preview build, validation and policy gates.
Source is Rasen Falcon v0.4.4 and external General Deployment v0.1-dev4; do not vendor or silently replace the deployment provider.
Local review target is a dedicated nested directory under /tmp; remote SSH, system install, HTTPS activation and production route updates are not accessible through this adapter.
All nine HTML pages must carry noindex,nofollow, robots disallow, content SHA-256 and complete source digest lock.
Positive local stage has 15 files and General Deployment generation d2585c2cae73fe3afcea00e1e2bbf4c91517291120ce6dfedf8edcc88f685ab1.
Public role check-release refuses without reviewed roles/public/manifest.tsv, services.txt, tests.tsv and owned native HTTPS and protocol tests; no fabricated unit/port/service evidence.
Source availability, local staging, target-host installation, process running and production acceptance are separate evidence states.
Public cutover requires independent operator approval, authenticated CMS/Brand/Wire receipts, qualified native HTTPS/SNI and target-host readiness; no fallback reverse proxy is authorized.
v0.4.5 role manifest contains 15 source-locked noindex site outputs and owned ooRexx serve.rex. A source-only manifest is not an install receipt.
The role deliberately lacks services.txt and tests.tsv until a qualified native HTTPS service and actual live probes are supplied by their owners; full check-release correctly fails closed.

provenance.claim: Local content-addressed stage and installation readiness evidence.
